kits.name: dam
kits.desc: Massive dam across a narrow rocky valley. state: 'ancient' = Egyptian Sadd el-Kafara style rubble core with stepped limestone block facing, crest walkway, workers' ramp, stone piles, low reservoir behind; 'broken' = the same dam with a V-shaped breach, tumbled blocks and muddy flood water rushing through (animated); 'modern' = concrete gravity dam with crest road + railings, stepped spillway channel with animated white water, intake tower and a full reservoir. Downstream face toward camera.

params.width: valley width at the crest m (default 10)
params.ramp: workers' ramp + stone piles (ancient, default true)

kits.name: pyramid
kits.desc: Egyptian limestone pyramid: 'giza' (fine stepped courses, gold capstone), 'stepped' (Djoser-style 6 big tiers) or 'smooth' (white casing). Optional unfinished state with a construction ramp.

kits.name: mudbrick_house
kits.desc: Egyptian / desert mud-brick house: thick walls with real door and small windows, flat roof with parapet, protruding palm-log beams, palm-frond awning on poles, outside stair to the roof, jars.

params.plaster: smooth mud plaster instead of bare bricks (default false)

kits.name: palm
kits.desc: Date palm: curved ringed trunk, drooping leaf-blade crown (pixel fronds), coconuts/dates. Fronds sway.

kits.name: workers_camp
kits.desc: Ancient builders' camp: canvas tent, stacked limestone blocks, a wooden sled hauling a block with ropes, rope coil, water jars, tools on the ground.

kits.name: water_mill
kits.desc: Water mill: stone base, timber+plaster mill house with gable roof, door/window, an overshot paddle wheel that ROTATES, wooden flume on posts with flowing water spilling onto the wheel, tail-race stream.

kits.name: boat
kits.desc: Hollowed log boat (dugout) like the reference reel: bark-textured log hull with carved interior, plank seats, mast with orange 'S' sail on yard and boom, rigging, two oars. Bobs gently.

kits.name: dock
kits.desc: Wooden dock / jetty: plank deck on log posts, mooring bollards, ladder, rope coil.

kits.name: house
kits.desc: Cosy village house (bakery by default, like the reference): clapboard walls on a stone footing, gable roof, brick chimney with rising smoke, door with frame, glazed windows, striped awning, sign board.

params.walls: siding_grey | siding_white | plaster | planks | red_brick | stone_brick

kits.name: barn
kits.desc: Red farm barn like the reference: vertical red board walls with white trim, big double doors with white X braces, hay-loft door, side windows, steep gable roof (ridge front-to-back), hay bales.

params.open: doors open showing the hay inside (default false)

kits.name: bridge
kits.desc: Bridge: 'stone' = arched limestone bridge with voussoir ring, parapets and ramps; 'wood' = log-beam plank bridge with posts and rails.

kits.name: well
kits.desc: Village stone well: round block wall, dark water inside, two posts with crossbeam, crank, little shingle roof, wooden bucket on a rope.

kits.name: cart
kits.desc: Wooden hand/ox cart: plank bed with side boards, two spoked wheels on an axle, shafts. Cargo optional. Wheels turn when moving=true.

params.cargo: hay | sacks | stones | crates | none (default sacks)

kits.name: crates
kits.desc: Stack of wooden crates with dark frames and braces.

kits.name: barrel
kits.desc: Wooden barrels (bulged staves, iron hoops, lid).

kits.name: pot
kits.desc: Clay pottery: amphora, wide storage jar or bowl (terracotta).

kits.name: tools
kits.desc: Builder's tools: shovel, pickaxe, wooden mallet/hammer - laid on the ground or leaning.

kits.name: tent
kits.desc: A-frame canvas tent with ridge pole, open front flaps showing a dark inside, guy ropes and pegs.

kits.name: sign
kits.desc: Wooden signpost: post with a framed board and an arrow board (text not rendered).

kits.name: fence
kits.desc: Fence run along X: wooden post-and-rail (default) or white picket.

kits.name: rock
kits.desc: Chunky low-poly boulder cluster.

kits.name: campfire
kits.desc: Campfire: ring of stones, crossed logs, animated flickering flames, rising smoke, warm light.

kits.name: generic
kits.desc: Fallback for any other noun: composed from primitive parts you list (box/cyl/cone/ball/wedge with size, base-centre position 'at', rotation degrees and a texture name or #hex). No parts -> a tidy crate of the given 'mat' and 'size'.
